title: SFBond 실버폭스 #100 · 바디페인팅(공예 Portuguese azulejo tile) · 목 링 벽 고리 + 발목 쇠공 · Japanese · late 40s · 헤어 natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff · 자유축 Core
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Japanese woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones, a soft, neutral expression, silver-white hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes. Long almond nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile — a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. A small smudge of soot touches her temple and jaw, with light grime on her fingers and the tops of her bare feet.

Restraints: She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the flagstones beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the flagstones, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes.

Background & Lighting: dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her, catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
